justification: No fixed release exists; reached only through record-node's blockstore-fs and datastore-fs, via it-glob and micromatch, which expand fixed internal patterns, never user input.
No fixed release exists; reached only through @helia/libp2p's autoTLS (acme-client), which record-node imports but never configures, so no RSA signature is verified with it.
No fixed release exists; reached only through electron-builder's @electron/get (got, cacheable-request), which downloads Electron and build tools while packaging, never in the shipped app.
